name: Emilia Komarova
source:
She’s been sent out to make sure that Camp Buddy meets all of the requirements set by the sponsorship, so Yoshinori and everyone else at camp had better make sure they’re prepared! She’s also got a bit of a history with the camp, though what exactly it is will have to be revealed later…

[From [url=https://www.blitsgames.com/scoutmasters-season-development-camp-buddy-translation-updates/]official site[/url]]
